hypothesis: Cropping the clearly isolated specimen on a uniform light background may reduce dependence on lighting, background and leaf scale while preserving the original CNN and all 177 outputs.
recipe: Only crop when each border is at least 85% bright gray pixels, there is 4% to 70% visible foreground, and an expanded foreground box occupies at most 85% of the frame. Compare a crop with averaged original-and-crop scores.
scoring: Master validation macro-F1 over all 177 labels; four represented supplement labels, with all 177 predictions eligible. Bugwood field fixtures are diagnostic only.
stop: Do not retune the foreground or promotion thresholds on these data.
